subtle.$description: Container-edge hairline within a surface: separators and inset edges for surface-scoped structure families (Accordion items, Card regions, Table rows, Tabs). Components address the container role rather than a palette step, so brands retune every container edge in one place. Mirrors color.border.subtle by default; override here to retune container edges without moving the raw border scale.

strong.$description: Container-edge border with more presence than subtle: outer container outlines and focus-adjacent edges where the edge itself carries structure. Same role vocabulary as surface.border.subtle — container edges, not control borders (controls use semantic.color.border.*).
